name: live-v28-24-reply-effort
objective: v2.8 24 T-R4 (row R4-live): the install-wide reply thinking budget on Artemis through llama.cpp Text Completion (3090 controller or a pod lane). For each level off / low / medium / high, two real group turns: every request sent while ST is generating a reply carries reasoning_budget_tokens equal to the level's budget (off 1, low 128, medium 400; high sends none), and no request sent outside a reply generation (memory, curator, judge-adjacent passes) carries a budget key. The level is put back by the runner's extraction-settings restore; thinking returns to the shipped level afterwards. Synthetic story and group only. Written, validated by the loader, not run yet.

requires.why: real replies on llama.cpp Text Completion; the budget overlay exists only there
